title: First Steps
subtitle: The exact entry sequence
text: If your blood is active, use Hemolytic Solution at the Unstained Podium to suppress it. Then build Lethean Baptism from Cleansed Stone and Lethean Poppies and invoke it with the Blood Crafting key. Baptism begins treatment; it does not make you a Church member. If your blood is healthy, speak with a Zealot and take the five service vows instead.
